visual_action: A man with a goatee and glasses is interviewed against a brick wall. The video cuts briefly to show him smiling and standing with politician Tim Walz before returning to the interview shot.

cast.name: unnamed Pennsylvania voter
cast.evidence: The man is the subject of the interview and is shown speaking for the majority of the video.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: The on-screen text states a former Trump voter is 'now voting for Kamala Harris' and the voter says 'I'm gonna vote for Harris and Walz.'

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The on-screen text identifies the speaker as a 'Former Trump voter'.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: He is shown on screen with the voter and the voter states, 'I'm gonna vote for Harris and Walz'.

cast.name: More Perfect Union
cast.evidence: The organization's logo appears in the top right corner of the video.

on_screen_text.text: Former Trump voter in PA is now voting for Kamala Harris 👇👇👇
Voter: “I’m seeing some things swinging in a positive way [for labor]. We just want to keep it going … I’m gonna vote for Harris and Walz.”

spoken_summary: An interviewer asks a man identified as a former Trump voter how he will vote. The voter says he sees things "swinging in a positive way" for labor and wants to keep that momentum going. He states he will vote for "Harris and Walz."
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of conversational dialogue between an interviewer and the subject. There is no music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a static talking-head interview with a single cut to a B-roll clip of the subject with Tim Walz.
central_claim: A former Trump voter in Pennsylvania is now supporting the Harris/Walz ticket due to their pro-labor stance.
intended_effect: To persuade swing voters, particularly those in the labor movement, that the Democratic ticket is gaining support from former Trump voters and is the better choice for workers.
